title: Applications for Immigration Permite made on behalf of Mr. and Mrs. Cawald Ettinger

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch. Station, D.
REPORT
File No. S. D. REGISTRY
Date February 25, 19 40.

Subject Applications for Immigration Permits made on behalf of Mr. and
Mrs. Oswald ETTINGER.

Made by D. S. Pitts Forwarded by D. I. Crawford

Although this office has not previously entertained
any applications for immigration permits from persons
not residing in Shanghai, grounds appear to exist for
treating the attached request made on behalf of Mr. and
Mrs. Oswald ETTINGER with sympathetic consideration.
The signatories of the letter dated January 26,
1940 addressed to the Committee for the Assistance of
European Jewish Refugees in Shanghai are all persons
holding responsible positions in British concerns in
Swatow and since Dr. Egon Ettinger, now domiciled in
that port, is medical officer to H.B.M. Consulate-
General and to the Chinese Maritime Customs in Swatow,
it would seem that he is able to care for his parents
in a fit and proper manner.
On the other hand, however, since Swatow is the
final destination of Mr. and Mrs. Oswald ETTINGER and
since this port is virtually under Japanese control,
it would appear more sensible if the application
were addressed to the Japanese authorities in Swatow.
The possibility exists, too, that if the prospective
immigrants were permitted to land in Shanghai and then
carried on to Swatow without permission from the
authorities there, they might be sent back here.

（批：C 23/2.）

D. S. Pitts.
D. S.

A. C. (Special Branch)

报告
档案号 S. D. 登记处
日期 1940 年 2 月 25 日。

事由：代表奥斯瓦尔德·埃廷格（Oswald ETTINGER）先生及夫人提出的入境许可证申请。

由 D. S. Pitts 呈报，经 D. I. Crawford 转递

尽管本处此前未曾受理非居住于上海人士提出的入境许可证申请，但看来有理由对随附的、代表奥斯瓦尔德·埃廷格先生及夫人的请求予以同情考虑。1940 年 1 月 26 日致上海欧洲犹太难民援助委员会的信函签署人，均为在汕头英资企业中担任要职的人士；鉴于目前定居该港口的埃贡·埃廷格（Egon Ettinger）博士系英国驻汕头总领事馆及中国海关汕头税务司的医官，他似乎能够以恰当且合适的方式照顾其父母。
然而，另一方面，由于奥斯瓦尔德·埃廷格先生及夫人的最终目的地是汕头，且该港口实际上处于日本控制之下，若将此申请提交给汕头的日本当局似乎更为明智。此外，还有一种可能性，即如果准移民获准在上海登陆，然后在未获得当地当局许可的情况下继续前往汕头，他们可能会被遣返回上海。

（批注：C 23/2。）

D. S. Pitts.
D. S.

助理处长（特务科）

Shanghai, February 20, 1940.

R. W. Yorke, Esq.,
Assistant Commissioner of Police,
Special Branch.

Dear Yorke,

I enclose herewith copy of a letter, and originals of
enclosures, from the Jewish Committee, regarding their recommendation
for the issue of a transit visa for Mr. & Mrs. O. Ettinger.

In the case of such applications for transit visa, I have
usually requested evidence of passage tickets to the port of final
destination and evidence from the port authorities that they will
permit landing, in order to ensure that the parties are not stranded
in Shanghai.

In view, however, of the persons who vouch for Dr.
Ettinger and his relatives, I feel that the Police may safely issue
a transit visa, if you agree that no reference to the Japanese
authorities in this matter is requisite.

Another way of looking at it is that the relative who is
coming from Swatow to Shanghai to meet the incoming parties, could
possibly have stayed in Shanghai and made application for and
received an ordinary entry permit to Shanghai in favour of Mr. & Mrs. O.
Ettinger.

If you agree that a Police permit can be issued, will
you please forward it to me for transmission, together with the
original enclosures.

Yours sincerely,

G. F. Ure.

X Returned

上海，1940 年 2 月 20 日。

R. W. Yorke 先生，
警务处助理处长，
特务科。

亲爱的 Yorke：

兹附上犹太委员会关于推荐为 O. 埃廷格先生及夫人签发过境签证的信函副本及附件原件。

在此类过境签证申请中，我通常要求提供前往最终目的地的船票证据，以及港口当局允许登陆的证明，以确保相关人员不会滞留上海。

然而，鉴于为埃廷格博士及其亲属担保的人士身份，我认为如果贵方同意此事无需知会日本当局，警务处可以安全地签发过境签证。

另一种看法是，那位从汕头来上海迎接 incoming parties（原文如此，指抵达者）的亲属，本可以留在上海，并为 O. 埃廷格先生及夫人申请并获得普通的上海入境许可证。

如果贵方同意签发警务处许可证，请将其连同附件原件一并转交给我，以便转送。

此致

敬礼，

G. F. Ure.

X 退回

19th February, 1940.

E. T. Nash, Esq.,
Secretary,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
Shanghai.

Dear Sir,

We beg to hand you herewith letter of Messrs.
Reiss, Bradley & Co., Ltd., Shanghai re
Mr. and Mrs. Oswald Ettinger, Vienna
together with a letter from Swatow, 1 certificate of
His Britannic Majesty's Consul, Swatow and 1 certificate
of the Commissioner of Customs, Swatow, which please re-
turn to us in due course.

We would be most grateful to you if you would
give this matter your kind attention and would grant the
necessary Transit-Visa for Mr. and Mrs. Ettinger as soon
as possible.

Thanking you in anticipation,

We remain, dear Sir,

Yours faithfully,

"I. C. " Organization for Immigrants

Paul Komor

Hon. Secretary.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ............
S. 1, Special Branch Station/
REPORT
Date February 3, 19 40.

Subject Central European Refugees - Letter from Messrs. Lloyd Triestino dated
January 31, 1940 addressed to the Shanghai Municipal Council.

Made by D.S. Pitts    Forwarded by D. I. Crawford

With reference to the contents of the attached
letter from Messrs. Lloyd Triestino relating to
the immigration into Shanghai of Mrs. Rosa GUTH and
child, due to arrive here on February 22, 1940 in
the s.s. "Conte Biancamano", there would appear to
be no objection to their residence in this port provided
they register with this office immediately after
disembarking. They left Europe prior to the incidence
of the Regulations of the Shanghai Municipal Council
but the outbreak of war hindered their journey to
the East. Permission has already been given for
other persons in the same circumstances to land here
and with this in mind there is no valid reason why
the two individuals concerned should not also.

D. S. Pits
C. 2/2.
C

Jo. Pitts
D. S.

A. C. (Special Branch).

Lloyd Triestino
informed by
D. S. Pitts
C 2/2

报告
日期 1940 年 2 月 3 日。

事由：中欧难民 - 劳埃德·特里埃斯蒂诺公司（Messrs. Lloyd Triestino）1940 年 1 月 31 日致上海公共租界工部局的信函。

由 D.S. Pitts 呈报，经 D. I. Crawford 转递

关于随附的劳埃德·特里埃斯蒂诺公司信函内容，涉及罗莎·古思（Rosa GUTH）夫人及其子女移民上海事宜，她们将于 1940 年 2 月 22 日乘坐“比安卡马诺伯爵”号（s.s. "Conte Biancamano"）轮船抵达此处。只要她们在登岸后立即向本处登记，其在上海居留似无异议。她们在欧洲出发时，上海公共租界工部局的相关条例尚未生效，但战争爆发阻碍了她们东行的旅程。此前已准许其他情况相同的人员在此登陆，有鉴于此，没有正当理由拒绝这两名相关人员登陆。

D. S. Pits
C. 2/2.
C

Jo. Pitts
D. S.

助理处长（特务科）。

劳埃德·特里埃斯蒂诺公司

26 The Bund,
Shanghai, January 31, 1940.

The Secretary & Commissioner General,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
Council Chamber,
Administration Building,
Shanghai.

Dear Sirs,

With reference to your letter No. K38/1 of the
29th November last in which you advised Messrs. Melchers
& Co., Agents Norddeutscher Lloyd Shanghai, that there is
no objection to the admission into the International
Settlement of 9 refugees, viz.

Mrs. E. Echt and 4 children
Mr. & Mrs. N. Renzer,
Mr. G. Aron
Miss R. Wolfsohn

We are now advised by the above Agents that also
Mrs. Rosa Guth and infant will be arriving in Shanghai, so
that the actual number of Emigrants totals 11.

In this connection we wish to recall the fact,
that these refugees arrived in Massowah by the s/s "COBURG".
They will probably continue their voyage to Shanghai by the
s/s "CONTE BIANCAMANO" due in Shanghai on February 22nd.

In view of these passengers having sailed for
Shanghai prior to the institution of landing restrictions,
we trust the matter will be in order.

Yours faithfully,

LLOYD TRIESTINO.

（批注：S... 5...）

外滩 26 号，
上海，1940 年 1 月 31 日。

秘书长兼总办，
上海公共租界工部局，
议事厅，
行政大厦，
上海。

尊敬的先生们：

关于贵局去年 11 月 29 日的第 K38/1 号信函，信中告知北德意志劳埃德公司上海代理梅切尔斯公司（Messrs. Melchers & Co.），对以下 9 名难民进入公共租界不持异议，即：

E. 埃希特（E. Echt）夫人及 4 名子女
N. 伦泽（N. Renzer）先生及夫人
G. 阿龙（G. Aron）先生
R. 沃尔夫松（R. Wolfsohn）小姐

现接上述代理人通知，罗莎·古思（Rosa Guth）夫人及婴儿也将抵达上海，因此实际移民总数为 11 人。

在此方面，我们要提请注意，这些难民是乘坐“科堡”号（s/s "COBURG"）轮船抵达马萨瓦（Massowah）的。他们可能会继续乘坐“比安卡马诺伯爵”号（s/s "CONTE BIANCAMANO"）轮船前往上海，该轮预计于 2 月 22 日抵达上海。

鉴于这些乘客在实施登陆限制之前已启程前往上海，我们相信此事将符合规定。

此致

敬礼，

劳埃德·特里埃斯蒂诺公司
